explanations: delayBeforeRetry() combines the gateway's Retry-After with our own backoff using Math.min, so the server's request only ever shortens the wait. A 429 with Retry-After: 20 is retried after a few hundred milliseconds, still inside the throttling window. That breaks the provider's rate limit and burns every attempt on guaranteed failures. Retry-After is a lower bound the client must respect. Taking Math.max waits at least as long as the gateway asked, and never less than the normal jittered backoff, so a Retry-After: 0 can't trigger a tight retry loop either.
